svg.title: Lantern Vale — concept C with a diagonal path
svg.desc: The selected sage-roof barn with a stone base and sliding timber gate, shown closed and open. The dirt path connects the barn door to the gate with a constant-width bend. Every long path edge follows an isometric ground-grid diagonal. This is an artwork prototype, not implemented gameplay.

g.text: LANTERN VALE / SELECTED CONCEPT C / PATH REFINEMENT
A cleaner way into the yard.
A constant-width path from the barn door to the gate, following the scene’s diagonal grid.
The gate slides beside the fence, clear of the path.
Sage roof · stone base · braced timber fence · sliding gate
SVG design review only. Gate controls and animal / worker access still need agreement before implementation.
